default.description: The header component features a clean, minimalist design with a white background and subtle rounded corners, giving it a modern and approachable appearance. It is framed by a soft shadow, which adds a sense of depth and separation from the content below. The overall look is simple and unobtrusive, allowing for easy integration with various content management systems.

variants.difference: In this variant, the header now includes a logo on the left, adding a focal point and brand identity to the design. Additionally, a navigation menu appears, providing structured links across the header, which enhances functionality and user navigation.
